summary.en: Surrounds and protects the brain.

detail.en: The skull forms a hard case around the brain. Many of its bones meet at seams called sutures. These seams allow little movement. You can select the skull bones as one group [S30].
detail.zh: 颅骨围成坚硬的外壳，保护脑。许多颅骨相接的地方叫骨缝，只能轻微活动。点选时，整组颅骨会一起选中 [S30]。

summary.en: Carries the lower teeth and moves at the jaw.
summary.zh: 承托下牙，并在颌关节活动。

detail.en: The mandible is the lower jaw bone and holds the lower teeth. It moves against the skull when you open your mouth or chew. Unlike most skull bones, it can move freely at its joints [S30].
detail.zh: 下颌骨承托下排牙齿。张嘴和咀嚼时，它相对颅骨活动。与大多数颅骨不同，下颌骨能在两侧的关节处明显活动 [S30]。

summary.en: Supports the head above the trunk.

detail.en: The neck bones support the head and surround the upper part of the spinal cord. When you turn or nod your head, small movements between neighbouring bones add up. You can select the neck bones as one group [S30].
detail.zh: 颈椎支撑头部，围护脊髓的上段。相邻椎骨之间的小幅活动合起来，让头能转动和点头。点选时，整组颈椎会一起选中 [S30]。

summary.en: Supports the ribs along the back.

detail.en: These back bones support the chest and meet the ribs. Together with the ribs and the breastbone, called the sternum, they form the rib cage around the heart and lungs. You can select these back bones as one group [S30].
detail.zh: 胸椎支撑胸部，并与肋骨相接。它们和肋骨、胸前的胸骨共同构成胸廓，围护心肺。点选时，整组胸椎会一起选中 [S30]。

summary.en: Passes weight from the upper body to the pelvis.
summary.zh: 把上半身的重量传向骨盆。

detail.en: The lower-back bones pass weight from the upper body towards the pelvis. The thick main part of each bone helps support this weight. The connections between these bones allow some bending. You can select them as one group [S30].
detail.zh: 腰椎把上半身的重量传向骨盆。每块腰椎粗厚的主体叫椎体，帮助承重。椎骨之间的连接让腰部能作一定程度的弯曲。点选时，整组腰椎会一起选中 [S30]。

summary.en: Links the spine with the pelvic ring.

detail.en: The sacrum is the broad bone at the back of the pelvis. It links the spine to the two hip bones and passes body weight into the ring formed by the pelvis. In an adult, several spine bones have joined together to form the sacrum [S30].
detail.zh: 骶骨是骨盆后方较宽的骨。它连接脊柱与两侧髋骨，把身体重量传入环状的骨盆。成人的骶骨由几块椎骨融合而成，也就是连成了一块骨 [S30]。

summary.en: Forms the small lower end of the spine.
summary.zh: 构成脊柱下端的小骨段。

detail.en: The coccyx is the small tail end of the spine below the sacrum. Muscles and ligaments attach around it. This small bone is part of the skeleton [S30].
detail.zh: 尾骨位于骶骨下方，是脊柱最下端的小骨段。周围有肌肉和韧带附着。这段小骨也是骨架的一部分 [S30]。

summary.en: Supports the front of the ribcage.

detail.en: The sternum is the flat bone down the front of the chest. Flexible tissue called costal cartilage links ribs towards it, helping form the protective rib cage. You can select its upper, middle and small lower sections together [S30].
detail.zh: 胸骨位于胸前正中，是一块扁骨。肋骨经有弹性的肋软骨向它连接，共同形成保护心肺的胸廓。点选时，胸骨的上、中、下三部分会一起选中 [S30]。

summary.en: Curve around the heart and lungs.
summary.zh: 弯绕在心脏和肺的外侧。

detail.en: The ribs curve from the back towards the front of the chest, enclosing the heart and lungs. A usual rib cage has twelve pairs. Seven pairs connect directly to the sternum through cartilage, and three join indirectly. The lowest two pairs have free front ends. You can select the ribs and their cartilage on each side as one group [S30].
detail.zh: 肋骨从背部向胸前弯曲，围护心肺。通常有十二对。七对经各自的软骨连向胸骨，三对间接相连。最下两对的前端游离，不与其他骨相连。点选时，每侧的肋骨和肋软骨会一起选中 [S30]。

summary.en: Curve around the heart and lungs.
summary.zh: 弯绕在心脏和肺的外侧。

detail.en: The ribs curve from the back towards the front of the chest, enclosing the heart and lungs. A usual rib cage has twelve pairs. Seven pairs connect directly to the sternum through cartilage, and three join indirectly. The lowest two pairs have free front ends. You can select the ribs and their cartilage on each side as one group [S30].
detail.zh: 肋骨从背部向胸前弯曲，围护心肺。通常有十二对。七对经各自的软骨连向胸骨，三对间接相连。最下两对的前端游离，不与其他骨相连。点选时，每侧的肋骨和肋软骨会一起选中 [S30]。

summary.en: Holds the shoulder away from the chest.

detail.en: The clavicle runs between the sternum and the shoulder blade. It helps hold the shoulder out from the chest so the arm has room to move. You can follow its curved shape across the top of the rib cage [S30].
detail.zh: 锁骨连接胸骨与肩胛骨。它把肩部撑在胸廓外侧，为手臂活动留出空间。沿着胸廓上方，可以看到它弯曲的走向 [S30]。

summary.en: Holds the shoulder away from the chest.

detail.en: The clavicle runs between the sternum and the shoulder blade. It helps hold the shoulder out from the chest so the arm has room to move. You can follow its curved shape across the top of the rib cage [S30].
detail.zh: 锁骨连接胸骨与肩胛骨。它把肩部撑在胸廓外侧，为手臂活动留出空间。沿着胸廓上方，可以看到它弯曲的走向 [S30]。

summary.en: Provides the socket for the upper arm.

detail.en: The scapula is the flat shoulder blade on the back of the chest. Its shallow socket meets the rounded head of the upper arm bone. Many muscles attach to it and help move both the shoulder blade and the arm [S30].
detail.zh: 肩胛骨是胸背部的扁骨。它外侧较浅的关节窝与肱骨的圆头相接。许多肌肉附着在这里，帮助肩胛骨和手臂活动 [S30]。

summary.en: Provides the socket for the upper arm.

detail.en: The scapula is the flat shoulder blade on the back of the chest. Its shallow socket meets the rounded head of the upper arm bone. Many muscles attach to it and help move both the shoulder blade and the arm [S30].
detail.zh: 肩胛骨是胸背部的扁骨。它外侧较浅的关节窝与肱骨的圆头相接。许多肌肉附着在这里，帮助肩胛骨和手臂活动 [S30]。

summary.en: Acts as a lever when muscles move the upper arm.
summary.zh: 在肌肉拉动上臂时充当杠杆。

detail.en: The humerus is the long bone of the upper arm. Its rounded head meets the shoulder blade, while its lower end helps form the elbow. Muscles pull on it to move the arm [S30].
detail.zh: 肱骨是上臂的长骨。上端圆形的骨头与肩胛骨相接，下端参与构成肘关节。肌肉拉动肱骨，使上臂活动 [S30]。

summary.en: Acts as a lever when muscles move the upper arm.
summary.zh: 在肌肉拉动上臂时充当杠杆。

detail.en: The humerus is the long bone of the upper arm. Its rounded head meets the shoulder blade, while its lower end helps form the elbow. Muscles pull on it to move the arm [S30].
detail.zh: 肱骨是上臂的长骨。上端圆形的骨头与肩胛骨相接，下端参与构成肘关节。肌肉拉动肱骨，使上臂活动 [S30]。

summary.en: Turns with the hand around the ulna.

detail.en: The radius is the forearm bone on the thumb side when the palm faces forwards. It turns relative to the ulna as you turn your palm up or down. The biceps tendon attaches to it and helps bend the elbow [S30, S32].
detail.zh: 手掌朝前时，桡骨位于前臂靠拇指的一侧。翻转手掌时，桡骨相对尺骨转动。肱二头肌的肌腱附着在桡骨上，帮助屈肘 [S30, S32]。

summary.en: Turns with the hand around the ulna.

detail.en: The radius is the forearm bone on the thumb side when the palm faces forwards. It turns relative to the ulna as you turn your palm up or down. The biceps tendon attaches to it and helps bend the elbow [S30, S32].
detail.zh: 手掌朝前时，桡骨位于前臂靠拇指的一侧。翻转手掌时，桡骨相对尺骨转动。肱二头肌的肌腱附着在桡骨上，帮助屈肘 [S30, S32]。

summary.en: Forms the main hinge at the elbow.
summary.zh: 构成肘部主要的铰链结构。

detail.en: The ulna is the forearm bone on the little-finger side when the palm faces forwards. Its upper end fits around the humerus to form the main elbow hinge. The triceps pulls on the bony point at its upper end to straighten the elbow [S30, S33].
detail.zh: 手掌朝前时，尺骨位于前臂靠小指的一侧。它的上端与肱骨相接，构成肘部主要的铰链，帮助前臂屈伸。肱三头肌拉动尺骨上端的骨性突起，使肘伸直。这个突起叫鹰嘴 [S30, S33]。

summary.en: Forms the main hinge at the elbow.
summary.zh: 构成肘部主要的铰链结构。

detail.en: The ulna is the forearm bone on the little-finger side when the palm faces forwards. Its upper end fits around the humerus to form the main elbow hinge. The triceps pulls on the bony point at its upper end to straighten the elbow [S30, S33].
detail.zh: 手掌朝前时，尺骨位于前臂靠小指的一侧。它的上端与肱骨相接，构成肘部主要的铰链，帮助前臂屈伸。肱三头肌拉动尺骨上端的骨性突起，使肘伸直。这个突起叫鹰嘴 [S30, S33]。

summary.en: Support the palm and fingers as a linked group.

detail.en: The wrist, palm and fingers contain many small bones linked by joints. These connections let the hand change shape for holding and gripping. One hand has 27 bones. In this whole-body view, you can select them as one group [S30].
detail.zh: 腕部、手掌和手指由许多小骨经关节连接而成。这些连接让手改变形状，完成握持等动作。一只手有27块骨。在全身视图中，点选时这些骨会一起选中 [S30]。

summary.en: Support the palm and fingers as a linked group.

detail.en: The wrist, palm and fingers contain many small bones linked by joints. These connections let the hand change shape for holding and gripping. One hand has 27 bones. In this whole-body view, you can select them as one group [S30].
detail.zh: 腕部、手掌和手指由许多小骨经关节连接而成。这些连接让手改变形状，完成握持等动作。一只手有27块骨。在全身视图中，点选时这些骨会一起选中 [S30]。

summary.en: Transfers weight and holds the hip socket.
summary.zh: 传递负重，并构成髋关节窝。

detail.en: Each hip bone forms one side of the pelvis and contains a hollow called the hip socket. The rounded head of the femur fits into it, helping pass weight into the leg. In an adult, three bones have joined together to form each hip bone [S30].
detail.zh: 每块髋骨构成骨盆的一侧。骨上的凹窝叫髋臼，容纳圆形的股骨头，帮助把重量传入下肢。生长过程中，三块骨逐渐融合，形成成人的一块髋骨 [S30]。

summary.en: Transfers weight and holds the hip socket.
summary.zh: 传递负重，并构成髋关节窝。

detail.en: Each hip bone forms one side of the pelvis and contains a hollow called the hip socket. The rounded head of the femur fits into it, helping pass weight into the leg. In an adult, three bones have joined together to form each hip bone [S30].
detail.zh: 每块髋骨构成骨盆的一侧。骨上的凹窝叫髋臼，容纳圆形的股骨头，帮助把重量传入下肢。生长过程中，三块骨逐渐融合，形成成人的一块髋骨 [S30]。

summary.en: Carries body weight through the thigh.
summary.zh: 沿大腿传递身体的重量。

detail.en: The femur is the long bone in the thigh. Its rounded upper end fits into the hip socket, while its lower end meets the shin bone at the knee. It carries weight and acts as a lever when leg muscles pull [S30].
detail.zh: 股骨是大腿里的长骨。上端的圆头嵌在髋臼内，下端与胫骨在膝部相接。它既承重，也在肌肉拉动时充当杠杆 [S30]。

summary.en: Carries body weight through the thigh.
summary.zh: 沿大腿传递身体的重量。

detail.en: The femur is the long bone in the thigh. Its rounded upper end fits into the hip socket, while its lower end meets the shin bone at the knee. It carries weight and acts as a lever when leg muscles pull [S30].
detail.zh: 股骨是大腿里的长骨。上端的圆头嵌在髋臼内，下端与胫骨在膝部相接。它既承重，也在肌肉拉动时充当杠杆 [S30]。

summary.en: Redirects the front thigh tendon at the knee.
summary.zh: 在膝前改变大腿前侧肌腱的走向。

detail.en: The patella is the kneecap at the front of the knee. It sits within the tendon of the front thigh muscles and changes the tendon’s path. This helps those muscles pull to straighten the knee [S30].
detail.zh: 髌骨位于膝前，嵌在大腿前侧肌肉的肌腱中。它改变肌腱经过膝部的走向。这样有助于这些肌肉拉动小腿、伸直膝关节 [S30]。

summary.en: Redirects the front thigh tendon at the knee.
summary.zh: 在膝前改变大腿前侧肌腱的走向。

detail.en: The patella is the kneecap at the front of the knee. It sits within the tendon of the front thigh muscles and changes the tendon’s path. This helps those muscles pull to straighten the knee [S30].
detail.zh: 髌骨位于膝前，嵌在大腿前侧肌肉的肌腱中。它改变肌腱经过膝部的走向。这样有助于这些肌肉拉动小腿、伸直膝关节 [S30]。

summary.en: Carries most lower-leg weight towards the ankle.
summary.zh: 把小腿大部分负重传向踝部。

detail.en: The tibia is the larger of the two lower-leg bones. It receives weight from the femur at the knee and carries most of the lower leg’s load towards the ankle. Its front edge forms the shin [S30].
detail.zh: 胫骨是小腿两块骨中较粗的一块。它在膝部承接股骨传来的重量，把小腿的大部分负重传向踝部。小腿前方的骨性边缘就是胫骨的一部分 [S30]。

summary.en: Carries most lower-leg weight towards the ankle.
summary.zh: 把小腿大部分负重传向踝部。

detail.en: The tibia is the larger of the two lower-leg bones. It receives weight from the femur at the knee and carries most of the lower leg’s load towards the ankle. Its front edge forms the shin [S30].
detail.zh: 胫骨是小腿两块骨中较粗的一块。它在膝部承接股骨传来的重量，把小腿的大部分负重传向踝部。小腿前方的骨性边缘就是胫骨的一部分 [S30]。

summary.en: Supports the outer side of the ankle.

detail.en: The fibula is the slender bone on the outer side of the lower leg. Its lower end helps form the outer ankle and supports that joint. It carries less body weight than the tibia [S30].
detail.zh: 腓骨是小腿外侧较细的骨。它的下端构成外踝，帮助稳定踝关节。它承担的体重比胫骨少 [S30]。

summary.en: Supports the outer side of the ankle.

detail.en: The fibula is the slender bone on the outer side of the lower leg. Its lower end helps form the outer ankle and supports that joint. It carries less body weight than the tibia [S30].
detail.zh: 腓骨是小腿外侧较细的骨。它的下端构成外踝，帮助稳定踝关节。它承担的体重比胫骨少 [S30]。

summary.en: Share load through the heel, arches and toes.
summary.zh: 经足跟、足弓和足趾分担负重。

detail.en: The foot bones spread weight through the heel, arches and toes. Their joints let the foot adjust as you stand and walk. A foot usually has 26 bones. Small extra bones within tendons, called sesamoid bones, are counted separately. You can select the foot bones as one group [S30].
detail.zh: 足骨经足跟、足弓和足趾分担重量。骨之间的关节让脚在站立和行走时作出调整。一只脚通常有26块骨。肌腱内还有一些叫籽骨的小骨，另行计算。点选时，整组足骨会一起选中 [S30]。

summary.en: Share load through the heel, arches and toes.
summary.zh: 经足跟、足弓和足趾分担负重。

detail.en: The foot bones spread weight through the heel, arches and toes. Their joints let the foot adjust as you stand and walk. A foot usually has 26 bones. Small extra bones within tendons, called sesamoid bones, are counted separately. You can select the foot bones as one group [S30].
detail.zh: 足骨经足跟、足弓和足趾分担重量。骨之间的关节让脚在站立和行走时作出调整。一只脚通常有26块骨。肌腱内还有一些叫籽骨的小骨，另行计算。点选时，整组足骨会一起选中 [S30]。

summary.en: Meets neighbouring wrist bones.

detail.en: The scaphoid is a small wrist bone near the thumb side. It meets neighbouring wrist bones, including the lunate, across smooth joint surfaces. This close-up moves the left wrist bones beside the body so you can compare their shapes [S30].
detail.zh: 舟骨是腕部靠拇指一侧的小骨。它通过光滑的关节面与月骨等相邻腕骨相接。近景把左腕的小骨移到身体旁，方便比较形状 [S30]。

summary.en: Meets other wrist bones along curved surfaces.
summary.zh: 以弯曲的关节面与其他腕骨相接。

detail.en: The lunate is a small wrist bone beside the scaphoid. Their neighbouring surfaces can glide by small amounts as the wrist moves. The name describes its curved, moon-like shape [S30].
detail.zh: 月骨是舟骨旁的一块腕骨。手腕活动时，它们相对的骨面能作小幅滑动。月骨的名字与它弯曲、像月牙的外形有关 [S30]。

summary.en: Sits centrally among the wrist bones.

detail.en: The capitate lies near the centre of the wrist bones. It helps link the wrist to the palm through its connections with neighbouring bones. Compare its rounded upper part with the smaller scaphoid and lunate beside it [S30].
detail.zh: 头状骨位于腕骨中央附近。它通过与相邻骨的连接，参与把腕部与手掌连起来。可以比较它圆形的上端和旁边较小的舟骨、月骨 [S30]。

summary.en: Forms the palm side of the index knuckle.
summary.zh: 构成食指指根靠手掌的一侧。

detail.en: This metacarpal is a palm bone below the index finger. Its rounded head meets the first finger bone at the knuckle. Their joint allows bending and straightening as well as some sideways movement [S30].
detail.zh: 第二掌骨是手掌内接在食指下方的骨。它的圆头与食指的第一块指骨在指根相接。这块指骨叫近节指骨。这个关节能屈伸，也能作一定程度的侧向活动 [S30]。

summary.en: Moves on the index metacarpal head.

detail.en: This is the first finger bone beyond the index knuckle. Its base rests against the rounded head of the palm bone below it, the index metacarpal. It moves there when you bend the finger or spread it sideways [S30].
detail.zh: 食指近节指骨是从指根往指尖数的第一块指骨。它靠近手掌的一端与第二掌骨的圆头相接。弯曲食指或向侧面张开时，它就在这个关节处活动 [S30]。

summary.en: Provides the base surface for the thumb.
summary.zh: 为拇指基部提供关节面。

detail.en: The trapezium is a wrist bone at the base of the thumb. Its surface fits the thumb metacarpal like two matching saddles. This shape allows movement in two main directions at the thumb base [S30].
detail.zh: 大多角骨是位于拇指基部的腕骨。它与第一掌骨的关节面像两个凹凸相配的鞍面。这种形状让拇指根部能沿两个主要方向活动 [S30]。

summary.en: Moves over the trapezium at the thumb base.
summary.zh: 在拇指基部的大多角骨上活动。

detail.en: The thumb metacarpal connects the wrist to the thumb. At its base, it meets the trapezium in a saddle-shaped joint. Movement here helps bring the thumb across the palm towards the fingers [S30].
detail.zh: 第一掌骨连接腕部与拇指。它在基部与大多角骨形成鞍状关节。这里的活动帮助拇指越过手掌，靠向其他手指 [S30]。

summary.en: Covers the upper bone end at the joint.
summary.zh: 覆盖关节内上方的骨端。

detail.en: Articular cartilage is the smooth covering on this upper bone end. It helps the facing surfaces move with little friction, or rubbing. The blue-grey cap follows the bone’s curve. The opening is enlarged to show the layers [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 关节软骨覆盖在这块上方骨的末端，表面光滑。它减小相对骨面之间的摩擦，让活动更顺畅。蓝灰色软骨帽贴着骨端的曲面。模型放宽了开口，方便看清各层 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Covers the lower bone end at the joint.
summary.zh: 覆盖关节内下方的骨端。

detail.en: This cartilage covers the lower bone’s facing surface. A thin space filled with fluid separates it from the opposite cartilage, keeping the two bones separate. The cartilage cap is made easier to see here [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 这层软骨覆盖下方骨相对的关节面。两侧软骨之间留有含滑液的薄隙，让两块骨保持分开。模型把软骨帽画得较明显，方便观察 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Encloses and lubricates the joint cavity.
summary.zh: 围住关节腔，滑液润滑相对表面。

detail.en: The joint capsule forms a sleeve around the space between the bone ends. Its inner lining makes a liquid called synovial fluid. This fluid helps the cartilage surfaces move smoothly. The wall is cut open to show the inside, with the fluid coloured blue-green [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 关节囊像套筒一样围住骨端之间的空间。它的内层叫滑膜，产生一种叫滑液的液体。滑液帮助软骨面顺畅活动。模型切开囊壁，用蓝绿色表示滑液，让内部结构可见 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Connect bone to bone across the joint.

detail.en: Ligaments are strong bands that connect bone to bone. These bands cross the outside of the joint capsule and help limit excess movement. They support the joint without actively shortening like muscles to pull it into motion [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 韧带是连接骨与骨的坚韧带状组织。图中的带子跨过关节囊外侧，帮助限制过度活动。它们支撑关节，不会像肌肉那样主动缩短来拉动关节 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Forms the bone’s dense outer wall.

detail.en: Compact bone makes the dense, hard wall around the middle of a long bone, called the shaft. This specimen follows the shape of a thigh bone, or femur. The cut face shows the wall’s thickness and the space for marrow inside. A thin outer covering called the periosteum is peeled back beside the opening [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 长骨中间的部分叫骨干，外壁由致密而坚硬的骨密质构成。这个标本按股骨（大腿骨）的形状绘制。切面显示骨壁的厚度，内侧是容纳骨髓的空间。开口旁翻起的薄层是骨的外膜，叫骨膜 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Supports the bone ends with a hard network of struts.
summary.zh: 以坚硬的骨小梁网架支撑骨端。

detail.en: Spongy bone is a network of hard struts with spaces between them. The connected struts help support the wide ends of this long bone. They are enlarged here so you can see the hard bone and the soft marrow in its spaces [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 骨松质由许多坚硬的小支柱连成网架。这些小支柱叫骨小梁，彼此之间留有空隙。相连的小梁帮助支撑长骨较宽的两端。模型放大了网架，方便看清硬骨与空隙内柔软的骨髓 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Fills spaces inside the bone.

detail.en: Marrow is soft tissue inside bones. Red marrow makes blood cells. Yellow marrow contains much fat. This cutaway shows red marrow among the struts at the bone’s ends and yellow marrow in its shaft. The pattern varies with age and from bone to bone [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 骨髓是骨内部的软组织。红骨髓制造血细胞，黄骨髓含有较多脂肪。这个截面显示骨端网架之间的红骨髓，以及骨干内部的黄骨髓。骨髓的分布随年龄和骨而不同 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Carries blood into the living bone.

detail.en: Bone contains living cells that need a blood supply. A blood vessel called the nutrient artery enters through the hard wall. It branches towards the tissues inside. The red branches are enlarged to show the route taken by blood [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 骨含有活细胞，需要血液供应。一条叫滋养动脉的血管穿过坚硬的骨壁，向内部组织分支。红色分支表示血液流经的通路，模型将它们放大，方便观察 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Shows the early gap and clot.

detail.en: A fracture is a break in the hard bone. It can also tear nearby blood vessels. Blood collects and clots around the break, shown here in dark red. This first specimen in the repair row still has a visible gap between the broken ends [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 骨折就是硬骨断裂，也可能撕裂附近的血管。血液在断处聚集并凝固，图中用暗红色表示。修复过程的第一个标本中，断端之间仍可见裂隙 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Shows a soft bridge around the break.
summary.zh: 显示断处周围的软性桥接。

detail.en: New tissue can form a bridge around the broken ends, called a soft callus. It is softer than mature bone and helps join the damaged region. The blue-grey bridge shows this tissue, which forms after the blood clot [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 断端周围可形成一座由新组织连成的桥，叫软骨痂。它比成熟骨软，帮助连接损伤区域。蓝灰色的桥表示血液凝块形成之后长出的软骨痂 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Shows a hard bony bridge.

detail.en: New bone replaces the softer bridge to form a hard callus. The thick, rough bridge around the break is now bone. This specimen shows a stage of repair; no healing time in days is set here [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 新的骨组织替代较软的桥，形成硬骨痂。断处周围粗大而粗糙的桥此时已是骨。标本表示修复的一个阶段，没有设定愈合天数 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Shows the reshaped bone outline.
summary.zh: 显示重新塑形的骨外形。

detail.en: The repaired bone can gradually reshape through remodelling. Extra callus is reduced and the shaft becomes smoother. A slight bulge may remain. The four specimens show the steps from left to right; each step can take a different length of time [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 修复后的骨可继续通过重塑调整外形。多余骨痂减少，骨干逐渐平滑，但仍可能留有轻微隆起。四个标本从左到右展示修复步骤，各阶段所需的时间可以不同 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Marks a growing bone’s cartilage region.
summary.zh: 标示生长中骨的软骨区域。

detail.en: A growth plate is a region of cartilage near the end of a young long bone. New bone replaces cartilage as the bone lengthens. The cut model shows the cartilage disc across the bone, with enlarged cell columns on its cut face. The adult skeleton beside it has no growth plate [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 生长板位于幼年长骨靠近骨端的区域，由软骨构成。骨增长时，新骨逐步替代软骨。剖开的幼骨模型显示横跨骨的软骨板，切面上的细胞柱已放大示意。旁边的成人骨架没有生长板 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Marks a surface being renewed.
summary.zh: 标示正在更新的骨表面。

detail.en: Bone tissue continues to renew itself after height growth stops. Old tissue is removed and new tissue forms. This process is called remodelling. The marked patch is a simple example of renewal in one area, rather than a measure of how fast a person’s bones grow [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 身高停止增长后，骨组织仍会更新。旧组织被去除，新组织形成，这个过程叫重塑。标出的区域示意一处骨组织的更新，不表示某个人骨生长的速度 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Pulls the radius to help bend the elbow.

detail.en: The biceps is at the front of the upper arm. Its tendon carries a pull across the elbow to the radius, helping bend the elbow. It can also help turn the palm upwards [S30, S32].
detail.zh: 肱二头肌位于上臂前侧。肌腱把它的拉力跨过肘部传到桡骨，帮助屈肘。它也帮助前臂转动，使手掌向上 [S30, S32]。

summary.en: Pulls the ulna to help straighten the elbow.

detail.en: The triceps lies at the back of the upper arm. Its tendon pulls on the upper end of the ulna to straighten the elbow. It produces the opposite elbow action to the biceps, although both muscles can help steady the joint [S30, S33].
detail.zh: 肱三头肌位于上臂后侧。它的肌腱拉动尺骨上端，使肘伸直。它与肱二头肌在肘部的主要动作相反，两者也能共同帮助稳定关节 [S30, S33]。

summary.en: Transmits a pull towards the radius.

detail.en: This tendon carries the biceps muscle’s pull to the radius. The pull crosses the elbow and helps turn the forearm at that joint. The short tendon segment is enlarged so you can see it clearly [S30, S32, S34].
detail.zh: 这段肌腱把肱二头肌的拉力传到桡骨。拉力跨过肘部，帮助前臂在肘关节处转动。模型放大了一小段肌腱，方便看清 [S30, S32, S34]。

summary.en: Transmits a pull towards the ulna.

detail.en: This tendon carries the triceps muscle’s pull to the ulna at the point of the elbow. The pull helps straighten the elbow. The short tendon segment is enlarged so its connection is easier to see [S30, S33, S34].
detail.zh: 这段肌腱把肱三头肌的拉力传到肘尖处的尺骨突起，也就是鹰嘴。这个拉力帮助肘伸直。模型把一小段肌腱放大，方便观察连接位置 [S30, S33, S34]。

summary.en: Carries the load around a fixed pivot.

detail.en: The beam turns around a fixed hinge called the pivot. In this simple model, the beam is 0.30 m long. The dot marks a pull point 0.04 m from the pivot. Place the same load at 0.15 m or 0.30 m and compare the pull needed to balance it. The model leaves out the beam’s weight. Its pull acts at right angles to the beam; it does not trace the real biceps’ pull [S34].
detail.zh: 这根梁绕固定铰链转动，铰链就是支点。这个简化模型中的梁长0.30 m。小圆点标出距支点0.04 m的拉力作用处。把同样的负载放在距支点0.15 m或0.30 m处，比较平衡它所需的拉力。模型忽略梁自身的重量。模型中的拉力与梁垂直，不表示真实肱二头肌的拉力方向 [S34]。

summary.en: Applies a vertical downward force.

detail.en: The block marks where an outside force pulls vertically down on the beam. Force is measured in newtons. Choose a force and compare the two distances from the pivot. Setting the force to zero removes this outside load. A real arm would still have other forces acting on it. The block marks the load’s position; its size tells you neither the force nor your muscle strength [S34].
detail.zh: 方块标出外加力竖直向下作用在梁上的位置。力的单位是牛顿。选择一个力，再比较负载与支点之间的两种距离。设为零会移除这项外加负载，真实手臂上仍会有其他力。方块标示负载的位置，大小不代表力的大小或你的肌力 [S34]。

summary.en: Shows where the bones lie inside an adult body.
summary.zh: 显示骨在成人身体内的位置。

detail.en: The faint body surface helps locate bones inside an adult body. Hide it to see the skeleton more clearly. It shows an adult outline and cannot predict a child’s body shape [S30].
detail.zh: 淡显的体表帮助看清骨在成人身体内的位置。隐藏体表后，骨架更容易看清。这是成人的轮廓，不能用来预测儿童的体形 [S30]。

summary.en: Marks the fixed centre of rotation.

detail.en: The fixed hinge marks the pivot of the ideal lever. The beam rotates around it [S34].
detail.zh: 固定铰链标出理想杠杆的支点，梁绕它转动 [S34]。

summary.en: Blood collects around the broken ends.

detail.en: Torn vessels release blood at a fracture. This clot occupies the space around the broken ends [S34].
detail.zh: 骨折会撕裂血管。凝血块占据断端周围的空隙 [S34]。

summary.en: Soft tissue bridges the broken ends.

detail.en: A soft callus forms around the broken ends. It helps hold them together before new bone replaces it [S34].
detail.zh: 断端周围形成软骨痂。新骨替代它之前，它帮助连接断端 [S34]。

label.zh: 由竖直向下转过的角度
